title: Strict transform commutes with affine pushforward
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_S$ be a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal [pqf-def-coherent], and let $b:S^b=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(S)\to S$ be its blowup [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism of $S$-schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism] and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $g_b:X\times_SS^b\to Y\times_SS^b$ for the base change [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $\mathcal F^b$ denotes the module strict transform relative to $\mathcal I$ [def-trf-module-strict-transform], then there is a canonical isomorphism $g_{b,*}\mathcal F^b\cong(g_*\mathcal F)^b$ of $\mathcal O_{Y\times_SS^b}$-modules.
